rows.english: It's almost lights out for the God of Darkness.
rows.turkish: Karanlıklar Tanrısı için ışıklar sönmek üzere.

rows.english: So, you're the broad who hunts monsters, huh? My kinda girl.
rows.turkish: Demek canavar avlayan kadın sensin, ha? Tam benim tarzım.

rows.english: A bad guy's a bad guy. No real difference between any of ' em.
rows.turkish: Kötü adam kötü adamdır. Hiç fark etmez.

rows.english: Quite a kingdom you got here.
Look at that turret.
I don't have time to wait for you.
Not bad, Fox… for a super-cop...
rows.turkish: Fena değil, Fox… bir “süper polis” için...

rows.english: You heard me coming, didn't you?
Sniper's not a threat anymore.
Seems like no version of me can catch a break…
rows.turkish: Görünen o ki benim hiçbir versiyonum rahat yüzü göremiyor…

rows.english: Cap, come on…you gotta get up.
Yeah? What you got in your trash can?
rows.turkish: Öyle mi? Çöp tenekende ne varmış bakalım?

rows.english: Come on! We gotta get to the Vault!
Thanks.
Squids are toast. Now my sights are on their king.
rows.turkish: Kalamarların işi bitti. Şimdi gözüm krallarında.

rows.english: You know a word I don't like? Nuance.
rows.turkish: Sevmediğim bir kelimeyi söyleyeyim mi? Nüans.

rows.english: Turret mode…locked!
I'm sure I've got something in my arsenal that could do the trick…
rows.turkish: Eminim cephaneliğimde işimi görecek bir şey vardır…

rows.english: Hold your horses. It takes a minute.
rows.turkish: Beni aceleye getirmeyin. Biraz zaman alacak.

rows.english: Riding shotgun for a spider. Life is strange.
rows.turkish: Bir örümceğe eşlik ediyorum. Hayat ne garip.

rows.english: Heavy weapons. I'm in love.
I'm gonna say no.
Frank Castle, reporting for duty.
Reminder: Now we have to defend it.
I don't usually team up with criminal scum like you, LeBeau.
rows.turkish: Genelde senin gibi suçlu pisliklerle iş birliği yapmam, LeBeau.

rows.english: That's what I needed.
Enemy was here.
You kids should stay out of this.
All patched up.
We took this area. Now hold it.
rows.turkish: Burayı ele geçirdik. Şimdi de kaybetmeyelim.

rows.english: Spider-Man gone? That one hurts.
rows.turkish: Örümcek Adam’ı mı kaybettik? Bu kez üzüldüm.

rows.english: You made your last mistake.
Destructible environment here.
High caliber.
Practically bulletproof.
Any luck findin' out about that lady you were lookin' for?
rows.turkish: Aradığın o kadın hakkında bir şey öğrenebildin mi?

rows.english: Like shooting squids in a barrel!
No more Amplifier.
Hate feeling weak!
There's somebody who needs a bullet.
Adding to your underworld army, huh?
Never thought I'd have to take Cap down.
rows.turkish: Kaptan’ı alt etmem gerekeceğini hiç düşünmezdim.

rows.english: I was made for this mission!
They call me the Jeff.
Target's down.
Get this vehicle where it needs to go.
rows.turkish: Bu taşıtı gitmesi gereken yere götürün.

rows.english: Need help here!
They're the superior force.
Let's ride, Big Red!
They call me the Punisher.
That's a big step.
Can't hold me forever.
Once Dracula's down, this war is over.
rows.turkish: Drakula’yı devirince bu savaş bitmiş demektir.

rows.english: Give Loki a problem? Let's do it;.
rows.turkish: Loki’nin başına dert mi açıyoruz? Hadi başlayalım.

rows.english: Bullseye.
Crazy clown.
War always has casualties, Cat. Watch your tongue, or you may end up one of 'em.
rows.turkish: Savaş her zaman kayıplar getirir, Kedi. Diline dikkat et, yoksa onlardan biri olabilirsin.

rows.english: Nothing like having the devil on your side!
Sniper! Chase em, don't let em get set up.
rows.turkish: Keskin nişancı! Peşine düşün, aman vermeyin!

rows.english: The Southern belle got rung. Stay focused.
Night night, mope.
Really? Ha! That's gonna make my life so much easier!
rows.turkish: Gerçekten mi? Ha! Bu hayatımı çok daha kolaylaştıracak!

rows.english: Smoked all the spiders.
Hmmm, I'm not done yet.
Stay away from Earth.
This core should scrap Ultron's plans.
rows.turkish: Bu çekirdek sayesinde Ultron’un planlarını bozabiliriz.

rows.english: I'm taking this place.
So, we're taking the tablet to the dragon? Got it.
rows.turkish: Yani, tableti ejderhaya mı götürüyoruz? Anlaşıldı.

rows.english: I ain't holdin' back. Not anymore.
rows.turkish: Artık kendimi tutmuyorum. Daha fazla değil.

rows.english: Gonna send that fanged freak straight back to his grave.
rows.turkish: O dişli ucubeyi doğru mezarına geri yollayacağım.

rows.english: You feel at home here, huh?
rows.turkish: Nasıl, evine dönmüş kadar oldun mu?

rows.english: We gotta get this metalhead to the tower! Now!
rows.turkish: Bu metal kafayı kuleye götürmeliyiz! Hemen!

rows.english: Swords and wooden stakes? Real cute.
rows.turkish: Kılıçlar ve tahta kazıklar mı? Gerçekten sevimli.

rows.english: Jeff here.
Heads up. Hostiles.
Geez. Ultron really did a number on this place.
rows.turkish: Vay canına. Ultron burayı fena dağıtmış.

rows.english: What the hell are those things, Namor?
We are… for now. But in this business, that can change in a heartbeat.
rows.turkish: Şimdilik öyleyiz… Ama bizim meslekte her an her şey değişebilir.

rows.english: Watch out. These spiders detonate.
There's still a fight ahead of us.
Knockin'em down.
Enemy target located.
I'm not a hero, I'm the Punisher.
My war, MY ground!
rows.turkish: Bu savaş benim, bu toprak BENİM!

rows.english: Turret's destroyed.
I don't help. I eliminate threats and scum who might be threats.
rows.turkish: Ben yardım etmem. Tehditleri ve tehdit olabilecek pislikleri ortadan kaldırırım.

rows.english: Nah. It broke down decades ago. Besides, tech from my era lets me keep my entire arsenal on-hand at all times.
rows.turkish: Yok. Onlarca yıl önce bozuldu. Hem benim dönemimin teknolojisi, tüm cephaneliğimi her an yanımda taşımama izin veriyor.

rows.english: Down and out.
I'm hunting criminals, Wade. Not throwing a birthday party for a six-year-old.
rows.turkish: Suçluları avlıyorum, Wade. Altı yaşındaki bir çocuğa doğum günü partisi düzenlemiyorum.

rows.english: Nice little boost.
Not for sale.
I'm a blunt instrument. That's how I like it.
rows.turkish: İnce çalışan birisi değilimdir. Böylesini severim.

rows.english: Nothin' like a good, old-fashioned prison break!
rows.turkish: Eski usul bir hapishane kaçışından daha iyisi yok!

rows.english: Now I'm getting mad.
Time to make the undead dead again.
Don't quit now! All these… things… are counting on us!
rows.turkish: Şimdi pes etme! Tüm bu… şeyler… bize güveniyor!

rows.english: Ah now drop faster.
You're my kinda rodent!
I like the future. It has kickass ordnance.
Punisher's got you.
Namor's got some extra help. Lucky us.
rows.turkish: Namor arkadaşlarını da getirmiş. Hadi yine iyiyiz.

rows.english: Punk down.
Hey kid, don't you stop here.
Judgement in progress.
Stop em here.
Hmph. At least the Beast's got my back.
rows.turkish: Hıh. En azından Beast arkamı kolluyor.

rows.english: I'll make them pay.
Got an endless supply of ammo with Wanda's name on it.
rows.turkish: Wanda'nın adı yazılı sonsuz bir cephane stoğum var.

rows.english: We here to take it back?
Someone should have stopped Doom a long time ago.
Later, Amplifier.
Zombies. All the carnage. None of the guilt.
rows.turkish: Zombiler. Tüm yıkım, hiçbir suçluluk duygusu yok.

rows.english: You hurt people, I hurt you.
Focus firepower here.
This wasn't the mission I signed up for when I joined your Resistance, Widow.
rows.turkish: Dul, Direniş’ine katıldığımda imza attığım görev bu değildi.

rows.english: War's a universal language, T'Challa. And I am fluent.
rows.turkish: Savaş evrensel bir dildir T’Challa. Ben bu dili sökeli çok oldu.

rows.english: Weapons are tools. And I'm the master craftsman.
rows.turkish: Her silah bir araçtır. Ben de usta bir zanaatkârım.

rows.english: Hang tight, squirrel. We'll be moving again soon.
You sure? We'd make a hell of a pair. If you're lucky, I might even let you raid my armory.
rows.turkish: Emin misin? Harika bir ikili olurduk. Şanslıysan, zırh depoma baskın yapmana bile izin verebilirim.

rows.english: Wanna put that to the test, old man?
rows.turkish: Bunu test etmek ister misin ihtiyar?

rows.english: We do not control this, and we need to.
rows.turkish: Burası bizim kontrolümüzde değil ama olmalı.

rows.english: Hunker down. We're almost there.
Rally here.
You're a shooter. Like me.
Who's got better guns NOW?
Hostiles up front!
You're not gonna whine about my methods?
I'm not a hero, I'm the Jeff.
I don't play favorites. I don't listen to excuses.
Anything that shoots in here?
Vampire Mutant with Fireworks. Sure.
Where'd you get the mech?
Wounded and injured, but I still carry on!
Step lively, or Loki's going to have all the chronovium he wants.
rows.turkish: Çabuk olun yoksa Loki tüm kronovyumu alacak.

rows.english: Hey. I don't tell you not to idolize the red, white, and blue, boy scout. Let me do me.
rows.turkish: Bak. Ben sana kaptana hayran olma diyor muyum? Herkes kendi işine baksın.

rows.english: Okay.
Escort to T'Challa, commence.
Enemy inbound! We don't budge an inch!
rows.turkish: Düşman geliyor! Bir santim bile kımıldamıyoruz!

rows.english: Please. I know where I'm going when my war is over. And it ain't pretty.
rows.turkish: Lütfen. Savaşım bittiğinde nereye gideceğimi biliyorum. Ve hiç hoş bir yer değil.

rows.english: Fire support, on the double!
You seriously think you can just switch sides 'cause the world's about to end? You've gotta be kiddin'…
rows.turkish: Dünya sona ermek üzere diye taraf değiştirebileceğini mi sanıyorsun? Şaka yapıyor olmalısın…

rows.english: Find cover and get ready to defend.
rows.turkish: Siper alın ve savunmaya hazır olun.

rows.english: More scum scraped off.
Breathing. Barely.
Extended my deployment.
Buckle up, kids. We're in for a hell of a ride.
rows.turkish: Kemerlerinizi bağlayın, çocuklar. Çılgın bir yolculuğa çıkıyoruz.

rows.english: I've got everything I need to get the job done.
rows.turkish: Görevi tamamlamak için ihtiyacım olan her şeye sahibim.

rows.english: Good, burn 'em all, kid.
Group up!
Something seems fishy here.
rows.turkish: Burada bir bit yeniği var gibi.

rows.english: That's ours. Let's get it.
Three's a start.
Straight from Hell!
I'm shipshape.
Thanks for the ride, big guy. I'll carry us home.
rows.turkish: Taşıdığın için sağ ol, iri adam. Bizi eve ben götürürüm.

rows.english: Get to Budokan! Now!
If you need giant robots, it's because you know your soldiers won't fight.
rows.turkish: Niye dev robotlara ihtiyacınız var? Askerleriniz savaşmadığı için mi?

rows.english: Need some ranged firepower.
Lights out for scum.
There's no chance I'm letting you put your filthy hands on my arsenal, Wade.
rows.turkish: Cephaneliğime o pis ellerini sürmene asla izin vermem, Wade.

rows.english: We're close to the Weaver. Finish the mission.
Get down. Sniper.
Only cowards see shades of gray.
rows.turkish: Hayat siyah beyazdır. Sadece korkaklar gri görür.

rows.english: Judge, jury…EXECUTIONER!!!
Old soldiers stick together.
Strange sprung a portal here!
Got a portal here. I'm watching.
Good thing I stocked up on silver bullets.
Gotta keep it up.
That's not it. We're alike because we both know there are some problems that can only be solved by force.
rows.turkish: Mesele o değil. İkimiz birbirimize benziyoruz çünkü bazı sorunların sadece şiddetle çözüldüğünü biliyoruz.

rows.english: When I'm done with that witch, there won't be nothin' left.
rows.turkish: O cadıyla işim bittiğinde geriye hiçbir şey kalmayacak.

rows.english: The Punisher's here, they're done.
You made a bad choice, kid.
Shoot these ankhs wherever you find them.
rows.turkish: Şu yaşam çarmıhlarını buldukça vurun gitsin.

rows.english: We deliver this essence or we go down trying!
rows.turkish: Ya bu özü teslim edeceğiz ya da bu uğurda can vereceğiz!

rows.english: Turret's blown. I'm infantry again.
Judge, jury…EXECUTIONER!!!
All good.
Coward, face me!
Picked off the sniper.
I didn't forget about you.
Let's get Spider-Zero where she needs to go.
Sorry I didn't dress up nice for your fancy ball, lady.
rows.turkish: Süslü balonuz için şık giyinmediğim için üzgünüm hanımefendi.

rows.english: Sounds pretty. But I don't think your brother would agree.
rows.turkish: Kulağa güzel geliyor ama kardeşinin hemfikir olduğunu sanmıyorum.

rows.english: On the move again.
I'll make them pay.
It ain't meant to be fashion. But it is a statement.
rows.turkish: Moda kaygısı yok, beni ifade etti mi yeter.

rows.english: I need to find cover.
Doing this solo? Good thing I brought extra firepower!
rows.turkish: Bunu tek başıma mı yapıyorum? İyi ki fazladan ateş gücü getirmişim!

rows.english: Bogeys incoming.
Nice work, Captain. Or is it Colonel?
rows.turkish: Güzel iş, Kaptan. Yoksa Albay mı?

rows.english: Maybe the rest of your ought to shoot faster.
Faster. We need to get to T'Challa.
Grrr… is that all you got?
All this cross-dimensional crap makes my head spin. I'm better off bustin' Public Eye thugs in a dark alley.
rows.turkish: Bu boyutlar arası zırvalık kafamı döndürüyor. Karanlık bir ara sokakta Kamusal Göz serserilerini pataklamak bana daha çok göre.

rows.english: I'll meet my family, but not today!
rows.turkish: Bir gün aileme kavuşacağım ama o gün bugün değil!

rows.english: Keep rolling. We're getting close to Budokan.
Don't stop now! Knull ain't coming back on my watch!
rows.turkish: Şimdi durmak yok! Knull’un dönmesine müsaade etmem!

rows.english: Get deeper into the web…
Hostiles detected here.
Want some advice? Sometimes ya gotta let go of the past and fight the battle that's in front of ya.
rows.turkish: Bir tavsiye ister misin? Bazen geçmişi bırakıp önündeki savaşa asılman gerekir.

rows.english: Prime attack location.
Time to make the undead dead again.
That's a real soldier.
Hate to see innocents all penned up. Let's set 'em free!
rows.turkish: Masumların kafeslere tıkıldığını görmek nefret verici. Hadi onları serbest bırakalım!

rows.english: No more worries about spiders.
Stop the vehicle here!
Can't believe I'm fighting along side with THE LEGEND, sir. We'll finally end this dirty war!
rows.turkish: EFSANENİN ta kendisinin yanında savaştığıma inanamıyorum. Bu çirkin savaşı nihayet bitireceğiz!

rows.english: We do not have numbers.
Double quick, people.
Afraid? Not me. If they build a rifle with that kinda force, I'm gonna be the first in line to buy one!
rows.turkish: Korkmuş mu? Ben mi? Öyle bir güçte tüfek yaparlarsa, satın almak için ilk sıraya ben girerim!

rows.english: I want that gun!
They're on your tail!
Where's your luck now, Felicia?
Justice, pure and simple.
Beacon's on the fritz.
How's the war?
Yeah? So’s the Kingpin. Doesn't make either of you any less guilty.
rows.turkish: Evet mi? Kingpin de öyle. Bu, ikinizi de daha az suçlu yapmaz.

rows.english: Yeah? Tell that to my rocket powered grenade launcher.
rows.turkish: Evet mi? Bunu roket gücüyle çalışan el bombası atarıma söyle.

rows.english: Funny. But you won't be laughin' when you see me in action!
rows.turkish: Komik. Ama beni iş başında görünce gülmeyeceksin!

rows.english: Set em up, knock em down.
Don't see Wolverine go down every day.
rows.turkish: Wolverine’in yenilmesi her gün görülecek şey değil.

rows.english: We're not in Hell's Kitchen anymore…
Not a chance, kid. My arsenal comes with me. Package deal.
rows.turkish: Şansın yok, çocuk. Cephaneliğim benimle geliyor. Paket anlaşması.

rows.english: Thanks for the target practice, Namor.
rows.turkish: Sayende atış talimi de yapmış oldum Namor.

rows.english: You know my weapons can still lock onto you, even when you're invisible.
rows.turkish: Görünmez olsan da silahlarımın sana kilitlenebildiğini unutma.

rows.english: Hope I brought enough bullets to win this stupid tournament…
rows.turkish: Umarım bu aptal turnuvayı kazanacak kadar mermi getirmişimdir…

rows.english: You don't want to become like me.
Yeah, I'm not traveling as much. Unless I get a blasted into another timeline.
rows.turkish: Evet, pek seyahat etmiyorum. Tabii bir başka zaman çizgisine sürüklenmediğim sürece.

rows.english: The Book of the Iron Fist, huh? I prefer War Journals…
rows.turkish: Demir Yumruk Kitabı, ha? Ben Savaş Günlüklerini tercih ederim…

rows.english: You gotta be kidding me, there's a dinosaur on our team now?
rows.turkish: Şaka yapıyor olmalısın, artık takımımızda bir dinozor mu var?

rows.english: Another bump in the road.
Pull out!
Bullseye.
Maybe for other people. Not for me.
rows.turkish: Belki başkaları için öyledir. Benim için öyle değil.

rows.english: This whole damn planet makes my skin crawl…
rows.turkish: Bu lanet gezegenin tamamı beni rahatsız ediyor...

rows.english: Free fire zone.
Hunting doesn't prep you for war, redhead.
rows.turkish: Avcılık seni savaşa hazırlamaz, kızıl saçlı.

rows.english: Devil's Curse!
I will. Then I'll be right back home cracking skulls in New York.
rows.turkish: Elimden geleni yapacağım. Sonra New York’a dönüp milleti dövmeye devam.

rows.english: Some kind of spider nest here.
rows.turkish: Burada bir tür örümcek yuvası var.

rows.english: I'm doing this MY WAY!!
Nest is neutralized.
Timestream Entanglement? What the hell does that mean?
rows.turkish: Zaman Akışı Karışıklığı mı? O ne demekmiş öyle?

rows.english: Smart choice, doll. You couldn't handle seein' what I've lived through.
rows.turkish: Akıllıca bir seçim, güzelim. Benim yaşadıklarımı görmeye dayanamazdın.

rows.english: 86'ed the Ankh.
Neutralized the ankh.
Good. Saves ME bullets.
Neutralized the turret.
Five down.
I'm good to go.
Blindsided!
Sorry, but I don't work for anyone's government. Not anymore.
rows.turkish: Üzgünüm, ama artık kimsenin hükümeti için çalışmıyorum.

rows.english: Been savin' a bullet with your name on it, Fisk!
rows.turkish: Adın yazılı bir mermiyi senin için saklıyordum, Fisk!

rows.english: I'm hit pretty bad.
Don't worry, I'm ready for the Hulk.
Thought I cleaned up Central Park ages ago…
rows.turkish: Central Park’ı temizleyeli uzun zaman oldu sanıyordum…

rows.english: Can’t wait to finally put you down, Fisk.
rows.turkish: Seni sonunda gebertmeyi iple çekiyorum, Fisk.

rows.english: Yeah hi.
This is not over.
Heard Alchemax was tryin' to create super-weapons based off your powers, Cyke.
rows.turkish: Alchemax’in senin güçlerinden yola çıkarak süper silahlar yapmaya çalıştığını duydum, Cyke.

rows.english: You know who killed him?
Someone had to shut you up, Wade.
rows.turkish: Seni susturması gereken biri vardı, Wade.

rows.english: Me against an undead army? I like those odds.
rows.turkish: Ben ve bir ölümsüz ordusu mu? Bu şansı severim.

rows.english: I don't listen to music. I punish criminals.
Then consider this another failed performance review, "Director."
rows.turkish: O zaman bunu da bir başarısız performans değerlendirmesi say, “Müdür.”

rows.english: "Home, sweet home" ain't lookin' so sweet these days…
rows.turkish: "ANA SAYFA, tatlı ANA SAYFA" bu günlerde pek tatlı görünmüyor…

rows.english: No one can hurt me!
Armored up.
We've gotta babysit a robot? Great.
rows.turkish: Robota bebek bakıcılığı mı yapıyoruz? Bir bu eksikti.

rows.english: Good, thanks.
I'm doing this MY WAY!!
Right is right and wrong is wrong.
Locked and loaded. Just need a target.
Speed it up, or I'm takin' the wheel!
Think you're fast enough to stop a high velocity round aimed straight between your eyes, old timer?
rows.turkish: Sence iki kaşının tam ortasına nişan alınmış yüksek hızlı bir mermiyi durduracak kadar hızlı mısın ihtiyar?

rows.english: That's a full fist.
Another notch on the belt.
Eat unlimited ammo!
This could all come down.
Amplifier's shorted out.
Blaze of glory.
Got your back.
Not a fan of S.H.I.E.L.D., but I appreciate the wheels.
rows.turkish: S.H.I.E.L.D. hayranı değilim ama tekerleklere saygım var.

rows.english: Beacon's neutralized.
Back for another tour.
Sniper let me get too close.
I feel a barrage coming on…
Bogey here.
Destination: Avengers Tower. Move out!
Different battlefield, same war.
rows.turkish: Savaş alanı değişse de savaş aynı savaş.

rows.english: All right, you filthy space rodent. Let's amp it up!
rows.turkish: Pekâlâ, seni pis uzay kemirgeni. Hadi şunu coşturalım!

rows.english: Can't let the vamps win! Keep going!
rows.turkish: Vampirlerin kazanmasına izin veremeyiz! Devam edin!

rows.english: Sniper, look out!
So long, turret.
Step on it. The king needs his cat statue.
Combat-ready again.
Always knew you'd turn bad.
I'll fight this war against crime until I fall.
Push harder! I'm not ending up in one of the Collector's cells!
rows.turkish: Daha fazla zorla! Koleksiyoncu'nun hücrelerinden birine düşmeye hiç niyetim yok!

rows.english: It's all about the unit.
Battlefield-ready again.
Robot spiders all over the place.
Ahha…Gonna do some damage.
This is our objective.
Shoulda stocked up on silver bullets…
That's a yes.
Portal! They're coming!
Get the space goop to the basement. Got it.
rows.turkish: Uzaydan gelen zamkı bodruma götürüyoruz. Tamamdır.

rows.english: Some sorta squids? Great…
rows.turkish: Bir tür kalamar mı? Bir bu eksikti…

rows.english: I've seen a lot of stuff I never signed up for in Special Forces.
rows.turkish: Özel Kuvvetlere katılınca hiç beklemediğim şeyler gördüm.

rows.english: Is that diamond skin of yours actually impenetrable?
rows.turkish: Şu elmas cildin gerçekten de delinmez mi?

rows.english: Let's save that tree. Ride.
You did real good, furball.
Nice shooting, Barton.
Like something I read in a comic when I was a kid.
rows.turkish: Çocukken okuduğum çizgi romanlardan fırlamış gibi.

rows.english: They ain't seen nothing yet.
Getting harder and harder to keep track these days…
Step it up. Time's short.
Ugh. Nothin' worse than magical fairylands…
rows.turkish: Of. Büyülü peri diyarlarından daha kötü bir şey yok…

rows.english: So weak.
This place could make me believe in magic.
rows.turkish: Burayı gördükçe insanın büyüye inanası geliyor.

rows.english: That's a job well done.
Let's see how immortal Dracula really is…
rows.turkish: Ölümsüz Drakula gerçekten ne kadar ölümsüzmüş, görelim…

rows.english: C’mon, Devil. Let’s ride!
Let me tell you something, Red. You're one bad day away from becoming me.
rows.turkish: Sana bir şey söyleyeyim, Kızıl. Beni anlamaya bir kötü gün uzaktasın.

rows.english: Come on! Is the dragon sleeping, or are we?!
rows.turkish: Hadi ama! Ejderha mı uyuyor, yoksa biz mi?!

rows.english: Hall of Djalia, let's roll.
Enemy's got too much firepower.
Better kick it up a gear if we're gonna save the tree.
Objective achieved. Good work.
That's a negative from me.
You wanna stay safe, squirrel? Stick with me.
rows.turkish: Güvende kalmak ister misin sincap? Yanımdan ayrılma.

rows.english: Watch out. Turret's armed!
Didn't think ya had it in you, Cyke.
rows.turkish: İçinde bu varmış, Cyke; hiç düşünmemiştim.

rows.english: I re-upped.
I know all about you, Rogue. Keep your hands where I can see 'em.
rows.turkish: Senin hakkında her şeyi biliyorum, Rogue. Ellerini görebileceğim yerde tut.

rows.english: Always liked Tokyo. But it wasn't always this spidery.
rows.turkish: Tokyo’yu hep sevmişimdir. Ama eskiden bu kadar örümcekli değildi.

rows.english: Two Dooms, huh? Target-rich environment.
rows.turkish: İki Doom demek. Bol bol hedef var desene.

rows.english: I didn't even have to push.
I'm hunkering down.
Why would I do that?
A Hydra base? Good thing I packed some extra magazines.
rows.turkish: Hydra üssü mü? Neyse ki yanıma birkaç yedek şarjör almıştım.

rows.english: When I'm done here, there won't be a thing left in mint condition!
rows.turkish: Buradaki işim bittiğinde, hiçbir şey mint condition olarak kalmayacak!

rows.english: I've been watchin' you, Sai. You're a hell of a hunter. Glad you're on my team.
rows.turkish: Seni izliyordum, Sai. Avcı dediğin böyle olur. Ekibimde olduğuna sevindim.

rows.english: Slowed me down.
Clipped your wing, angel!
What are we waitin' for! Let's move this stupid tablet!
rows.turkish: Ne bekliyoruz! Hadi şu aptal tableti taşıyalım!

rows.english: The Beacon's kaput.
This is way outside my comfort zone.
rows.turkish: Bu benim rahatlık alanımın çok dışında.

rows.english: Give it a try, Fox, and we'll see how many of those tails you have left after…
rows.turkish: Denemeye devam et, Tilki, ve bakalım o kuyruklarından kaç tanesi kalacak…

rows.english: So? Is that supposed to scare me or something?
rows.turkish: Ee? Bu beni korkutması mı gerekiyor?

rows.english: I was always coming back for you.
Looks like bullets break your magic.
Full power shooting!
I miss my van.
Step lightly. Might be more ankhs.
rows.turkish: Adımlarınıza dikkat edin. Daha fazla yaşam çarmıhı olabilir.

rows.english: Pull back!
Time to clear the dance floor… by force!
rows.turkish: Dans pistini boşaltmanın vakti geldi… Zor kullanarak!

rows.english: Look over there.
New entry in the War Journal.
I'll take good care of your guns!
Bad choices have bad consequences.
rows.turkish: Kötü seçimlerin sonuçları da kötü olur.

rows.english: What the hell is this place supposed to be?
rows.turkish: Burası neyin nesi supposed to be?

rows.english: Defend this location.
Final Judgement is ready.
We don't deliver this core, Arakko falls. Let's go!
rows.turkish: Bu çekirdeği teslim etmezsek Arakko düşer. Hadi gidelim!

rows.english: Hey I'm watching you. Make one move I don't like and I'm dropping you on the spot.
rows.turkish: Bak, gözüm üzerinde. Hoşuma gitmeyen tek bir hareketinde seni anında yere sererim.

rows.english: Better make this count.
Outta sight!
War is hell, right, Barnes?
rows.turkish: Savaş, cehennemin ta kendisidir, değil mi Barnes?

rows.english: Wilson? Really? >Sigh< Just kill me now…
rows.turkish: Wilson mı? Cidden mi? >İç çeker< Şimdi beni öldürün…

rows.english: Hasta la vista, robot.
Follow me, I'm invincible.
Smokescreen!
Take a rest.
I need medical support!
Agh, I don't need healing anyway.
We're a long way from Coney Island…
Never thought I'd care so much about spiders. Ride out.
rows.turkish: Örümcekleri bu kadar önemseyeceğimi hiç düşünmezdim. Yola çıkalım.

rows.english: Ankh is off the menu.
That was a losin' hand, LeBeau.
Hey, behind us!
Stay close, H.E.R.B.I.E. This is getting ugly.
What the -- ?!
Bucky. Always feels good going into a fight with you.
rows.turkish: Bucky. Yanında savaşa girmeyi hep sevmişimdir.

rows.english: Anything that increases my firepower, I like.
rows.turkish: Ateş gücümü artıran her şeyi severim.

rows.english: When I find whoever did this to the world, that will be a bad day for them.
rows.turkish: Bunun sorumlusunu bulduğumda yaptıklarından pişman olacak.

rows.english: The Winter Soldier. It's an honor. You're one of the best in the business.
rows.turkish: Winter Soldier. Benim için şereftir. Mesleğin en iyilerinden birisin.

rows.english: Out of the infirmary.
Heh. Never figured I'd have something in common with a talking raccoon.
rows.turkish: Heh. Konuşabilen bir rakunla ortak bir yanımın olabileceğini hiç düşünmemiştim.

rows.english: Castle here.
Flushed the other Frank out.
At least I know I can trust you.
We know the mission. Let's move!
Smoke up!
Move it or Arakko's done for!
rows.turkish: Harekete geçin yoksa Arakko’nun işi biter!

rows.english: Move this vehicle along!
Hold the perimeter! Time's on our side.
Never thought I'd see the day, Devil. You finally gave in to your dark side.
rows.turkish: Şeytan, bu günü göreceğimi hiç düşünmezdim. Sonunda karanlık tarafına teslim oldun.

rows.english: Marc and his ankhs.
War Journal entry: This world is officially sick, a talking raccoon's got better guns than me.
rows.turkish: Savaş Günlüğüme ekleyeyim: Bu dünya resmen delirmiş. Konuşabilen bir rakunun silahları benimkinden iyi.

rows.english: And I thought the shark was weird…
Got a little run going.
I'll take your word, Wade. But I'd rather skip lunch and save the extra space for more bullets.
rows.turkish: Sana inanıyorum, Wade. Ama öğle yemeğini pas geçip o ekstra boşluğu daha fazla mermiye ayırmayı tercih ederim.

rows.english: You look like you belong in high school. What are you?
Intercept the target vehicle!
We've got our mission. Let's move this core!
Watch the landing.
Got a good field of fire. Next stop, the Weaver.
rows.turkish: İyi ateş yağdırdık. Sonraki durak Dokumacı.

rows.english: Punishment is almost ready.
Thought the Horsemen of Apocalypse were supposed to be scary…
rows.turkish: APOCALYPSE'in Atlıları'nın korkutucu olması gerekmiyor muydu…

rows.english: Right behind you!
Good, this is where I make my stand.
You and me, Spector. We're two of a kind.
rows.turkish: Sen ve ben, Spector. İkimiz bir elmanın iki yarısıyız.

rows.english: Got my own cover. Nice.
Can't even get help.
